{{Sagittarius}}
Sagittarius 1 is the 1st day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 1st day of Sagittarius, and it is a Monday. It corresponds to ISO week 1, weekday 1.

Its informal Japanese name is 1宮1日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 1|Chapter 1]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152021}}.

[[Category:Days with weekday Monday]]

[[Category:Dates with custom text]]
===Chapter summary===
Aster, the cosmic catgirl, creates the universe from yarn but longs for companionship. She weaves Andromeda, her counterpart, yet the two are separated by space, their threads forming galaxies. Their love symbolizes the cosmos’ destiny, with hope of reunification at the Omega point in eternal harmony.
